doctrine: Pixieset is a unified platform replacing 5-6 separate tools (gallery, print fulfillment, CRM, invoicing, contracts, scheduling). Core operational value flows from integration: lead capture → project → contract/invoice → proofing collection → client favorites → final edited delivery → print store with automatic lab fulfillment (WHCC, ProDPI, Miller's, Mpix, Loxley Colour, Atkins Pro). End-to-end workflow: (1) capture lead via inquiry/website/manual entry in Studio Manager; (2) send contract + deposit invoice; (3) send pre-session questionnaire; (4) upload unedited selects to proofing collection with watermark and favorite limit matching package; (5) client selects favorites in real-time; (6) edit only favorited images; (7) deliver final gallery with download PIN and enabled print store; (8) enable automatic fulfillment (lab prints/ships under white-label, no Pixieset branding); (9) send balance invoice if applicable; (10) post-delivery follow-up at 48 hours (satisfaction + referral) and 90 days (reactivation + gallery upsell). Key operational features: Collections (gallery containers), Folders (group collections), Watermarks (3 per account, removed for print/high-res, applied on display), Privacy options (public/password-protected/private), Download PINs per collection, Download size control (web-sized 640-2048px vs original/high-res 3600px vs 4K video), Activity tracking (who downloaded when), Favorites workflow with limit enforcement, Reset favorites for second round proofing, Branded custom domain (CNAME setup to domain.pixieset.com, +A records for root domain), Email campaigns targeting gallery viewers/past customers, Automated expiry reminders, Lead capture from gallery email access, Studio Manager features: Contact database (manual + auto-capture from inquiries/sign-ins/purchases), Invoicing (deposit + milestone + balance splits, Stripe/PayPal/offline tracking, separate from Store payment connections), Contracts (digital signature, scope/terms/cancellation/usage rights), Questionnaires (wardrobe, shot list, event details, headcount, special requests), Booking system (client-facing calendar, auto-creates project with contact/contract/invoice/questionnaire), Projects (unified client lifecycle: contact + contract + invoice(s) + questionnaire + collection(s) + notes), Email Templates (reusable, for sharing/follow-ups/automated reminders), Price Sheets (multiple for different client types, assign per collection, markup = client price - lab cost - Pixieset COGS fee), Store Settings: Order Delay (hold orders for review before lab fulfillment), Digital downloads alongside prints, Boutique packaging options, Tax setup (manual by region or TaxJar for US), Export for accounting. Lightroom plugin for direct export to collections. Video support: MP4/MOV/AVI/M4V, 1080p/2K recommended, H.264 codec.

workflows: Lead-to-delivery: inquiry/website contact → Studio Manager manual entry → send contract + invoice → send questionnaire → collect responses → shoot → upload proofing collection → client favorites → edit favorites only → deliver final gallery with download PIN and store enabled → send balance invoice → 48h follow-up (satisfaction + referral) → 90d follow-up (reactivation + gallery upsell)

Proofing: upload all unedited selects with watermark + favorite limit matching package → share via email with instructions → monitor selections real-time → lock favorites → edit only hearted images → deliver final edited collection with download PIN

Print fulfillment: enable store on collection → create/assign price sheet with markups → connect Stripe/PayPal in Store settings → enable automatic fulfillment → lab prints/ships to client under white-label → optional order delay for review before lab send
Second-round proofing: reset favorites on same collection → client re-selects → lock new selection → edit second round → replace images in collection or create new collection

Multi-client event delivery: bulk-create collections for one event → share all via folder link → each client has separate favorite limit and gallery → deliver edited per client preferences → store enabled on all
Email campaign: target clients who viewed gallery or past customers → use branded email templates → track opens/clicks → time for seasonal promos, mini-session announcements, print sale pushes
prompts: What is your package tier for this client? [Answer determines favorite limit.]
Do you want to review/edit crops or photos before the lab prints this order? [Answer determines whether to enable order delay.]
Should clients have the option to buy digital downloads from this gallery, or prints only? [Answer determines digital download pricing setup.]
When should this gallery expire for downloads and access? [Answer determines auto-reminder timing.]
What markup do you want on each product (5x7, 8x10, canvas, metal, etc.)? [Answer determines price sheet configuration.]
Do you want to do one round of proofing or allow a second-round selection? [Answer determines whether to reset favorites or deliver after first round.]

operating_rules: Watermarks are applied to display images only; automatically removed for original/high-res downloads and all print orders.
Watermark PNG should have transparent background, minimum 1600px wide.
Set favorite limit per collection to match the client package (e.g., 'Your package includes 20 edited images; select up to 20 favorites').
Edit only the images clients marked as favorites; do not edit unselected photos.
Studio Manager payment connections (invoicing) and Store payment connections (print store) are separate; connect Stripe/PayPal to both independently.
Orders going to the print lab under automatic fulfillment are printed/shipped by the lab under white-label packaging; no Pixieset branding visible to client.
Order Delay must be enabled to review/edit crops, replace photos, or modify shipping address before the order reaches the lab; highly recommended to prevent printing errors.
Price sheets define your markup: client price = lab cost + Pixieset COGS fee + your markup. Create multiple price sheets for different client types or product lines.
Assign the correct price sheet to each collection; incorrect price sheet means incorrect client pricing.
TaxJar (US only) requires separate setup in Store > Settings > Taxes. Manual tax rates must be set by country/region for all other locations. Pixieset does not file or remit taxes.
Custom domain CNAME requires 24 hours for SSL certificate generation; test after TTL expires (default 1 hour).
High-res downloads (3600px) and 4K video downloads only available on Pro and Ultimate plans.
Lightroom plugin streams editing-to-delivery pipeline; alternative: drag-and-drop file uploader.
Contacts captured from gallery sign-ins, inquiry forms, or store purchases are automatically added to Studio Manager; link them to specific collections/projects to activate CRM workflow.
Expiry reminder emails are configurable in Settings > Email Templates; enable before setting collection expiry dates.
Video formats supported: MP4, MOV, AVI, M4V. Recommended: 1080p/2K, H.264 codec.
Post-delivery timing: 48-hour follow-up for satisfaction check + referral ask; 90-day follow-up for reactivation + gallery upsell reminder.
Email campaigns track opens and clicks; use for seasonal promos, mini-session announcements, and print sale pushes.
Projects are the unified container for a single client engagement: contact + contract + invoice(s) + questionnaire + collection(s) + notes. All interactions for that client live in one project.
Booking system auto-creates a project with contact, contract, invoice, and questionnaire when a client books; reduces manual setup friction.

weird_gold: Pixieset handles the full B2B-to-B2C workflow in one place: the photographer's CRM (B2B: client/contract/invoice) flows directly into the gallery delivery pipeline (B2C: client downloads/prints), which then connects to passive print sales. No context switching.
White-label automatic fulfillment means zero inventory risk and zero fulfillment labor; the margin is pure markup after COGS, making it passive income. 'You never touch the product.'
Order Delay is a quality gate that fixes printing errors before they ship; built-in, not a separate QC step. Prevents the expensive mistake of reprinting.
Favorites workflow eliminates the back-and-forth of 'which photos do you want edited?' by making it real-time and client-driven. The photographer only edits what the client hearted.

Price sheets are per-collection, not global, allowing different markups for different client types without switching platforms. A wedding collection can have different print pricing than a headshot collection.
Email templates + expiry reminders create a passive urgency loop: collection expires, email reminder goes out, client orders before deadline, photographer gets passive sale.
Projects are the unified container that ties lead to final delivery: one contact, one contract, one invoice, one questionnaire, one collection, one payment. No scattered tabs or spreadsheets.
Booking system auto-creates the project + contract + invoice + questionnaire on client selection, eliminating the manual setup friction between 'client booked' and 'ready to gather info.'
